question: By selling an article for ₹20, a dealer makes a profit of 10%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹, round off to two decimal place) so as to make a profit of 40%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) = ₹20

Profit = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Cost price (CP) = SP / (1 + Profit%)

New SP for desired profit% = CP × (1 + Desired Profit%)

Increase in selling price = New SP - Original SP
